name: devops-hive-vscode-context
description: Publishes the currently-open file, selection, and workspace roots to ~/DevOpsHive/state/vscode-context.md so Claude Code + Munder agents can see what you're working on right now.

devopsHive.contextPath.description: Absolute path to write the context file. Empty = ~/DevOpsHive/state/vscode-context.md

devopsHive.debounceMs.description: Debounce interval in milliseconds — rapid file switches / selection changes coalesce to one write.

devopsHive.includeSelection.description: Include current selection text in the context file (truncated to 2KB). Turn off if editing sensitive code you don't want agents to see.
